title: Geo Point Field: Add Locations to Content Items | Orchard Core
description:
Some content belongs on a map: a shop, an office, a venue. A text field can hold an address, but not a point that an editor picks on a map or that a search can use.

The Geo Point field of the Spatial feature stores a latitude and a longitude on a content item. Editors type the two numbers or click a map, and the location is shown on the site and can be indexed for Lucene searches.

In this video:
• What the field stores, and its two editors
• Enabling the Spatial feature
• Adding the field to a content type, with Required, Hint and the Leaflet editor
• Setting a location by clicking the map or typing the numbers
• Checking the saved location in the editor and on the site
• What happens to the location after you save
